dag_infos.description: New Taipei City population aged 15 and above by age band, educational attainment measure and gender. The 15-19 and 35-39 detail bands cross 18-35, so youth conversion is apportioned rather than exact.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市十五歲以上現住人口教育程度（按年齡別、性別）
data_infos.source_type: 新北市資料開放平臺 data.ntpc.gov.tw
data_infos.dataset_description: 資料集提供1998至2024年新北市十五歲以上現住人口按年齡組、教育程度指標與性別的計數。DAG保留15歲以上總人口摘要列與各年齡組明細，行政區層級為新北市全市65000。
data_infos.etl_description: Fetch page=0,size=5000 until an empty page, with a browser User-Agent. Normalize field/itemvalue aliases by role, parse 15歲以上總人口 and all age bands into integer bounds, and raise on unknown labels. Emit every official metric cell exactly once for 計／男／女; do not add overlapping attainment fields together. The source has one documented internal mismatch in 1998 age 25-29 itemvalue19 (total 250 versus male 0 plus female 98); raw source values are retained and the mismatch is allow-listed, while any new mismatch raises. A yearly summary count is compared with the other-year median and a more-than-threefold scale change raises. The 18-35 classification is apportioned only for detailed age bands; no rate scaling or age inference is performed.
